membership.limitations: Both recordings have already informed tuning. Cross-recording results are sensitivity evidence, not a pristine holdout. MacWhisper exports are machine references. Sparse manual edits from other recordings are not whole-meeting validation.

human_review: Not adjudicated; private review packs require listening. Machine-reference agreement only.

models.role: installed assets; saved-artifact replay performs no model inference

provenance.timing_policy: Serial inference; two preparations per recording. One run, uncontrolled warm caches; no speed or memory improvement claimed.
provenance.toolchain:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.27.1 clang-2100.3.27.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0

alignment.method: unicode casefold + Unicode word runs; SequenceMatcher autojunk=False

reference.kind: machine reference, not human ground truth

time_sensitivity.unit: saved words, greatest positive time overlap; fixed lexical mapping
